package.description: Support for the 2026 Steam Controller in Non-Steam games, with DualShock4 and DualSense Support.

en-US.description: Support for the 2026 Steam Controller in Non-Steam games, with DualShock4 and DualSense Support.
en-US.longDescription: This fork turns a Steam Controller into a virtual Xbox 360, DualShock 4, experimental DualSense, or Switch Pro Controller. The main branch goal is parity with the original Xbox 360 behavior plus native PlayStation/Nintendo controller features for games that support them.
en-US.name: SteamlessController
